_meta.purpose: Mapping audit for RL-based common tree. Every RL leaf and every Shufersal leaf is assigned to exactly one common leaf.

matchKindLegend.direct-subgroup: RL subgroup code mapped directly to corresponding common leaf
matchKindLegend.direct-group-general: RL group without subgroups mapped to synthetic /general leaf
matchKindLegend.name-similarity: Shufersal leaf mapped to nearest common leaf by token similarity
matchKindLegend.fallback-first-leaf: No lexical overlap; fallback to first available common leaf
